svg.aria-label: Instant refresh: Every database mutation triggers an instant refresh through SQLite WAL monitoring. Live-editable since 2.0: Title, description, points, status and multi-agent assignments (with per-assignment models). Change flags: Every edit raises a change flag. The Claude session sees it and acknowledges it at its next context load. Completion stays earned: The UI can never set DONE or qa_verified
